verdict.rationale: Synctera clearly supports account creation and multiple account types (DDA, checking/savings, credit card) via its accounts API, implying it can generate accounts programmatically at scale, but the evidence never explicitly mentions unique routing number issuance, virtual accounts for reconciliation, or sub-account/master-account hierarchies. missing for 10: explicit routing-number-per-account documentation, virtual account / reconciliation account creation, and sub-account-under-master-structure support.
